benchmark.method: 300 sequential offscreen frames including GPU wait, BGRA readback and RGBA swizzle; does not measure live drawable FPS
benchmark.source: procedural gradient and grid; no media decoder in benchmark
benchmark.unmeasuredMetrics: GPU/CPU utilization and decoder frame drops require separate profiling; Metal command times exclude CPU work.

checks: projective UV GPU vs CPU homography, four pixel centers, ±2/255 tolerance
mesh grid identity and displaced center
asynchronous GPU readback and bounded overlapping sampling
PNG import, texture upload, all four oriented quadrants
oversized finite and nonfinite seek input
rapid seek completion preserves final target and pause
multiple output consumers share the paused decoder texture
repeated video surfaces use one frame with matching retained CoreVideo ownership
missing media diagnostic and deterministic fallback
unavailable/unauthorized camera diagnostic; no privacy request
300 consecutive offscreen frames without command failure
scope: Local offscreen Metal and AVFoundation checks; external displays, projectors and lighting hardware are not verified.
